trigger: inspect, configure, verify, checkout recovery, runtime recovery, or focused validation returns nonzero/incomplete state
dependencies: 30k opencode-lsp domain and selected failure-recovery route are current
repair remains inside the harness-owned failure boundary
steps: for WRONG_REPOSITORY route through the registered checkout recovery router, which resolves the fresh canonical default branch/head and delegates to the bounded checkout resolver

for OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND route through the registered runtime recovery router; separate WSL command discovery from version health so an existing but unhealthy OpenCode command is not mistaken for a usable runtime

if OpenCode is absent or its bounded version probe times out/fails, perform one bounded OpenCode-only install through the official installer pinned to $HOME/.opencode/bin, give that managed directory PATH precedence, then independently rediscover the command and version before writing the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim

after runtime recovery run initialization, write opencode-runtime-recovery.json and opencode-runtime-recovery.md for every terminal runtime stage including failures before Inspect; persist stage/exit/output-presence only, not raw command output, environment dumps, credentials, or inherited OpenCode configuration
do not delegate OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND or unhealthy runtime repair to broad technician setup or install unrelated agent tools such as AGY
bound network-backed OpenCode installation and the automatic Inspect handoff and fail with named timeout/dependency boundaries instead of hanging indefinitely
never emit the same failing gate as its own next action when a bounded owned resolver or repair route exists
repair the first owned failing boundary only
never weaken repository identity, privacy, config-preservation, immutable-output, or validator gates
rerun the failed gate first, then the focused floor
outputs: repaired exact-head validation or named external blocker
failurePolicy: stop when repair requires product code, credentials, confidential data on a free endpoint, unsupported upstream runtime, missing bounded-install prerequisites, a failed official installer after one bounded attempt, or another owner's mutation
handoff: record owner, dependency, artifact path, exact head, and executable next action; observation-only or same-state retry commands are insufficient when a bounded owned resolver or repair route exists
proofCeiling: same as the repaired gate; failure recovery does not promote proof
